source_base: Bractwo_0.8.18_UI_19 extracted from verified UI_18 archive
coverage: Protection requires attunement and grants AC plus every saving throw
Resistance is immediate and does not stack multiplicatively
Free Action distinguishes magical restraints from physical control
Warmth rolls 2d8, clamps at zero, and affects only Cold
Swimming gives 40 feet but not underwater breathing
Adamantine prevents natural-20 and condition-induced critical dice
Weapon, shield and armor enchantments retain their distinct bonuses
Mithral removes strength and armor-specific Stealth penalties
Attunement requires completion of an uninterrupted short rest
Attunement limits, duplicate copies, death and 24-hour separation
Legacy ring migration preserves UIDs without granting attunement
Native monster flight and Polymorph movement replacement
Integer gold trading preserves exact SRD value; temporary loss of physical contact invalidates attunement
integration_note: Read-only core review confirmed damage grouping before Warmth and the save/load/step/death/rest hooks. Full world and frontend validation belongs to the root agent.
